My job was looking for voluntary quits so I 'retired' in june, it was a cushy governnent job with nontransferrable skills, but the time seemed right because my port was just crossing the threshold into FIRE territory. I made the mistake of not full porting voo when i quit, I had actually slow grinded my NW up to that 2M figure over years (it didnt just all fall into my lap during the semis boom) so I tricked myself into believing I could still hold single stock picks and keep performing well with low volatility in retirement. Of course it was all an illusion, july happened, I was overweight semis, I got shrekt, I dipped harder into leverage to try to recover losses, turns out I wasn't smart just lucky, now 4 months later I just have 500k. And if you calculate my initial investment vs now I underperformed NQ since 2020.

My job was so niche I am not sure there is a job market for me out there anymore, my agency don't want me back and anyways what I did was on the brink of being automated away with AI. I guess this is the place a lot of people are at these days being unemployed with an obsolete skill set and I should be happy I 'saved' and have a nice cushion still. Better than most people in their 30s.

But there were like 3 weeks where I felt like I'd really done it and escaped the matrix. Now I'm here and idk. Lost all confidence in my ability to outsmart the market anymore so I can't bring myself to gamble with this money anymore. But with 500k in index funds I will chew through in like a decade. Then I'll just be penniless with a 10 year gap in employment. So now I have the impossible choice of keep trying to gamble the money back (90% prob I fail at this if this year's performance) or accept my fate, live confortably for 10 years and then just fucking die I guess. Wtf do I do. Every choice is aids.
